list_current_alerts.description: List the weather alerts MET Norway has in force now (yellow, orange and red warnings for wind, rain, snow, gales, ice and more), for all of Norway or one county, a point, a kind of weather or a level. Each comes with what to expect, what to do and when.

alerts.area: Parts of Troms and northern Nordland
alerts.consequences: Flooding will occur: There is a risk of flooding in urban areas. Water may enter homes. Difficult driving conditions: There may be difficult driving conditions due to flooding and risk of hydroplaning. Roads may be closed, and there could be a lot of water on the road, especially near streams and rivers. Many trips may experience longer travel time. Flooding and landslides: NVE issue flood and landslide warnings.
alerts.description: From monday morning until tuesday forenoon, heavy rainfall is expected, locally 50-80 mm in 24 hours in lower areas.
alerts.instruction: Flooding will occur: Clear drains and gutters so water can flow away. Difficult driving conditions: Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Consider if travel is necessary. Some places may lose road access: Follow advice from local emergency authorities. Flooding and landslides: Check warnings at Varsom.no.
